summary: Frontend-only testing for ElektroWatt one-page marketing site. All required data-testid elements render, Croatian diacritics display correctly with no mojibake, hero title reads 'STRUJA KOJA / RADI ZA VAS.', contact-mailto and contact-phone have correct mailto:/tel: hrefs, FAQ accordion expands on click (verified items 0 and 2), all 5 gallery Pexels images load (naturalWidth > 0), services nav-link scrolls to services section, mobile menu opens via nav-mobile-toggle at 390x844. No console errors. Desktop (1920x800) has no horizontal overflow. Mobile (390x844) shows horizontal overflow — minor design issue.

issues: document.scrollWidth > clientWidth => horizontal overflow on mobile. Likely due to the rotated 'OVLAŠTENI IZVOĐAČ · EST. 2004' side label in Hero (absolute, -rotate-90) or large hero typography on small viewports. Hide the side label on <md or add overflow-x:hidden on main/body.

action_items: Fix horizontal scroll on mobile (390x844). Suggested fix: add `overflow-x-hidden` on the root <main> container in App.js OR hide the rotated decorative side label in Hero on small screens (already has md:flex; verify the rotated transform isn't producing overflow on the right). Adding `overflow-x: hidden` to <html>/<body> is the safest fix.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js imports BrowserRouter but only declares a single '/' route — acceptable for a one-page site; consider HashRouter or removing router entirely since site uses in-page anchors.
Hero side label uses -rotate-90 with origin-left and absolute positioning; verify it doesn't cause horizontal overflow on intermediate breakpoints.
constants/site.js: phone is hardcoded; OK for marketing site. Mailto subject is URL-encoded correctly.
All required data-testid attributes present and well-structured.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is fully static. All test IDs verified. Only outstanding issue is mobile horizontal overflow at 390x844 — minor CSS fix needed.
